title: Filling Tseitin clause auxiliaries
statement: Given an assignment of signs to $n$ coordinates, a list of literals, and a list of auxiliary literals, process the first four literals whenever at least four remain and an auxiliary is available. Set the auxiliary coordinate to the negative of its required sign if either of the first two literals holds under the assignment, and to its required sign otherwise; update the assignment at that coordinate, then continue with the negation of the auxiliary literal followed by the third and fourth original literals and the remaining literals, using the remaining auxiliaries. When this process stops, return the current assignment.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of signs to the $n$ coordinates.
An input list of literals of dimension $n$.
An input list of auxiliary literals of dimension $n$.
